scenes.title: Wanting to Break Past Mere Senior-Junior Boundaries
scenes.summary: Right after kissing Ye-jin on the playground swing, trembling Seung-chan tells flustered Ye-jin he wanted to break past their senior-junior label rather than miss his chance again.

scenes.title: The Real You Is Even Better Than You Think
scenes.summary: On her final night before moving, Ye-jin wonders aloud if low self-esteem made her put up a tough front; Joon-mo warmly tells her she is far more lovable than she thinks and never to forget it.
scenes.location: Joon-mo's living room late at night

scenes.title: I Took the Road Less Traveled By
scenes.summary: Helping his mother put on a sheet mask after his late walk, Seung-chan asks when his father first felt like a man to her and recites the poem about choosing the road less traveled.
scenes.location: Baek family living room at night

scenes.title: I Am Truly Glad You Are in My Life
scenes.summary: On moving morning, Jum-soon rescues Ye-jin from a strict neighbor scolding her over recycling day, and Ye-jin shakes Joon-mo's hand goodbye, telling him how glad she is to have him in her life.
scenes.location: apartment parking lot on moving morning

scenes.title: Winning Ratings Seems Like Winning People's Hearts
scenes.summary: Over lunch, Tae-ho warns Joon-mo that the next two or three weeks of ratings will decide whether his show gets axed, leading Seung-chan to reflect that winning ratings is just like winning a person's heart.
scenes.location: Chinese restaurant and KBS interview room

scenes.title: Chasing New Guests Only Loses the Regulars You Already Have
scenes.summary: Evicted from their booked conference room by the triumphant pilot crew because low ratings tank a producer's clout, Joon-mo and Ji-yeon weigh desperate ratings stunts against protecting loyal viewers.

scenes.title: Trending Number Three Is Beggar Cindy!
scenes.summary: Already stung to learn CEO Byun diverted her luxury sponsorships, Cindy explodes when 'Beggar Cindy' memes from Seung-chan's preview hit number three in search rankings and speeds to Yeouido, while Ye-jin waits for her late moving truck.
scenes.location: Cindy's dressing room, van, and Ye-jin's new apartment

scenes.title: Like a Crystallization of Loveliness You Want to See Every Day
scenes.summary: Posting her manager outside an empty waiting room so she can chew out Seung-chan over 'Beggar Cindy,' Cindy melts completely when Seung-chan earnestly calls the character a lovable gem people want to see every day.

scenes.title: Should We Not File a Complaint About the Missing Streetlamp?
scenes.summary: Rescuing Ye-jin from an unhelpful moving driver at night, Seung-chan and Joon-mo both show up uninvited to unpack her boxes, bicker over chores, and worry over the dark unlit streetlamp outside.

scenes.title: To Me, Senior Ye-jin Feels Like an Unreachable Forty-Percent Dream Rating
scenes.summary: After Seung-chan compares Ye-jin to an unreachable forty-percent dream rating, Director Jang treats the junior staff to gourmet burgers to poach them—while Seung-chan loyally stays behind with Joon-mo over instant noodles.

scenes.title: Could We Settle My Remaining Debt All at Once Tonight?
scenes.summary: Seung-chan drops off a thoughtful housewarming gift at Ye-jin's desk with Il-yong and texts her to settle his remaining debt all at once tonight, while Ye-jin seeks love-triangle advice over coffee.
scenes.location: Music Bank office and KBS cafe

scenes.title: I Always Only Heard About Them Through Our Cindy
scenes.summary: Coming home to find CEO Byun and an entertainment reporter waiting inside her apartment via master key, Cindy watches in horror as Byun feigns ignorance and pins the agency's fabricated family story solely on fourteen-year-old Cindy.

scenes.title: My Parents Were Loving and Honest People
scenes.summary: Unaware CEO Byun signaled the cameraman to keep rolling, tearful Cindy confesses the truth about her late parents—only for Byun to cut her off right before Cindy names her, while a former agency manager phones Joon-mo.
scenes.location: Cindy's living room and Joon-mo's apartment

scenes.title: I Hate That My Excuse to Be with You Is Gone
scenes.summary: Settling his final debt with Ye-jin over dinner, Seung-chan admits he hates losing his excuse to see her; when Ye-jin tearfully thanks him for making her feel valuable, he asks for time until his feelings become natural to her.
scenes.location: outdoor cafe and bus stop at night

scenes.title: Knowing Someone Had Good Intentions Can Still Be a Great Comfort
scenes.summary: As CEO Byun's edited scoop paints Cindy as a habitual liar and Cindy quietly sends her manager on vacation, Seung-chan pleads with Joon-mo not to abandon her—arguing that sincere goodwill comforts someone even without a perfect outcome.
scenes.location: Cindy's apartment and KBS parking lot

scenes.title: It Is My Shoot and My Cast Member—I Will Handle It Myself
scenes.summary: Ordered by Director Jang and Tae-ho to cut Cindy loose and take CEO Byun's new rookie, Joon-mo reveals the former star is living happily, flatly refuses to abandon Cindy, and hounds the district office until Ye-jin's streetlamp gets fixed.
scenes.location: Director Jang's office and Ye-jin's apartment street
